subtitle.zh: 10 天理解 DDP、FSDP2 与可恢复训练
subtitle.en: Understand DDP, FSDP2 and recoverable training in 10 days

description.zh: 从单进程基线扩展到多进程数据并行，理解通信、采样、性能与检查点，再为 FSDP2 建立正确的内存与执行模型。用小模型训练工程验证方法，不以大模型或大集群作为入门门槛。
description.en: Grow a single-process baseline into multi-process data-parallel training. Study communication, sampling, performance and checkpointing, then build the correct memory/execution model for FSDP2. Validate ideas with a small training project instead of requiring a large model or cluster.

hoursPerDay.en: 120–180 minutes a day; about 20–30 hours total

prerequisites.zh: 能够写出并解释单机 PyTorch 的 forward、loss、backward 和 optimizer.step；理解张量、梯度与基本进程概念。
prerequisites.en: Write and explain a single-device PyTorch forward/loss/backward/optimizer loop. Understand tensors, gradients and basic processes.

hardware.zh: 基础通信与 DDP 教学可在支持 Gloo 的 CPU 环境运行；真实多卡扩展、NCCL 和 FSDP2 实验需对应版本支持的多 GPU 环境。无 GPU 选择分析与 CPU 分支。
hardware.en: Basic collectives and DDP can run on CPU when Gloo is available. Real multi-device scaling, NCCL and FSDP2 labs require compatible GPUs. The no-GPU route uses CPU exercises and design analysis.

zh: 训练框架工程师
分布式训练工程师
AI 平台工程师
en: Training framework engineer
Distributed training engineer
AI platform engineer

outcome.zh: 一个能验证数据覆盖、训练一致性与恢复流程的小型分布式训练仓库，以及 DDP/FSDP2 选型与容量分析。
outcome.en: A small distributed-training repository with data-coverage, training-consistency and recovery checks, plus a DDP/FSDP2 selection and capacity analysis.

title.zh: 保存一个可信的单进程基线

lesson.zh: 分布式训练首先要保持训练语义。没有稳定的单进程基线，就无法判断差异来自通信、数据划分还是原来的模型代码。固定小数据集、初始化、损失定义和优化器，记录每一步处理了哪些样本。种子只是复现信息的一部分，算子、平台和版本也会影响确定性；不要要求不适合的场景达到逐 bit 相同。
lesson.en: Distributed training must preserve the intended training semantics. Without a single-process baseline, differences cannot be attributed to communication, data partitioning or preexisting model code. Fix a small dataset, initialization, loss definition and optimizer, and record which samples each step consumes. Seeds are only part of reproducibility: operations, platforms and versions also matter, so bitwise equality is not always an appropriate target.

task.zh: 编写一个小型分类或回归模型，使用自建小数据集。保存初始权重、固定数量训练步后的权重、loss 序列、样本 ID 和环境记录；定义后续比较的数值容差。
task.en: Create a small classifier or regressor on self-generated data. Save initial weights, final weights after a fixed number of steps, loss history, sample IDs and environment. Define tolerances for later comparisons.

evidence.zh: single_train.py、初始检查点、基线结果与复现说明。
evidence.en: single_train.py, an initial checkpoint, baseline results and reproduction notes.

zh: 训练循环与 loss reduction 定义明确
重新运行能解释差异，并能追踪每一步样本
en: Define the loop and loss reduction explicitly
Explain rerun differences and trace samples at each step

noGpu.zh: 小模型与合成数据可以完全在 CPU 上训练，不需要下载大型数据集。
noGpu.en: Train the small model on synthetic data entirely on CPU; no large dataset download is needed.

title.zh: 理解 rank、进程组与集体通信
title.en: Understand ranks, process groups and collectives

lesson.zh: rank 是进程在通信组内的身份，world size 是组内进程数，local rank 通常用于映射本机设备。集体通信要求参与进程以兼容的顺序调用对应操作，张量形状和类型也必须匹配。all-reduce、all-gather 和 reduce-scatter 解决不同数据交换需求。先用小张量验证语义，可以避免把进程协调错误误认为网络性能问题。
lesson.en: A rank identifies a process within a communication group, world size counts its processes, and local rank commonly maps processes to local devices. Collectives require participating processes to call compatible operations in the same order, with matching tensor expectations. All-reduce, all-gather and reduce-scatter serve different exchange patterns. Small tensor examples help distinguish coordination bugs from network-performance problems.

task.zh: 在可用的 Gloo CPU 环境启动两个进程，让每个 rank 提供不同数值并执行 all-reduce。再画出 all-gather 与 reduce-scatter 的输入输出分布，解释求和与平均的区别。
task.en: Launch two processes in a working Gloo CPU environment. Give each rank a different value and perform all-reduce. Diagram all-gather and reduce-scatter inputs/outputs and explain the difference between summing and averaging.

evidence.zh: collectives.py、双 rank 日志和三种通信示意图。
evidence.en: collectives.py, two-rank logs and diagrams for three collectives.

zh: 两进程获得预期归约结果并正常清理进程组
能说明 rank 与 local rank 在多机下为何不同
en: Both processes obtain the expected result and clean up their group
Explain why rank and local rank differ across nodes

noGpu.zh: 本课优先使用 CPU/Gloo。若当前 PyTorch 未编译相应后端，完成数组级通信模拟并注明环境限制。
noGpu.en: CPU/Gloo is the preferred exercise. If the installed build lacks that backend, simulate collective array semantics and record the limitation.

caption.zh: 保存为 collectives.py；用 torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=2 collectives.py 启动，要求已安装支持 Gloo 的 PyTorch
caption.en: Save as collectives.py and launch with torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=2 collectives.py; requires a Gloo-enabled PyTorch installation

code.content:
import torch
import torch.distributed as dist

if not dist.is_gloo_available():
    raise RuntimeError("This exercise requires the Gloo backend")
dist.init_process_group("gloo")
try:
    rank = dist.get_rank()
    value = torch.tensor([float(rank + 1)])
    dist.all_reduce(value, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
    print({"rank": rank, "sum": value.item()}, flush=True)
finally:
    dist.destroy_process_group()

title.zh: 把单机训练改造成 DDP

lesson.zh: DDP 复制模型并同步梯度，但不会自动为你划分输入数据。各 rank 计算自己的 loss，再通过同步得到用于更新的梯度；若每个 rank 的样本数或 loss 权重不同，简单平均可能不再等价于预期的全局目标。比较单进程和 DDP 时，应保持有效全局 batch、初始化与优化器语义一致，而不是只比较每个进程的 batch size。
lesson.en: DDP replicates a model and synchronizes gradients; it does not automatically partition your input data. Each rank computes a local loss and participates in gradient synchronization. Unequal sample counts or loss weights can make a simple average differ from the intended global objective. Compare single-process and DDP runs with equivalent effective global batch, initialization and optimizer semantics, not merely equal per-process batch sizes.

task.zh: 将第 1 天模型改为两个 rank 的 DDP，手动划分一个可核对的小 batch。比较一次更新后的参数与等效单进程更新，解释误差和 loss reduction 的影响。
task.en: Convert the day-1 model to two-rank DDP and partition a small inspectable batch. Compare parameters after one update with an equivalent single-process update. Explain discrepancies and loss-reduction effects.

evidence.zh: ddp_train.py、参数差异报告和全局 batch 推导。
evidence.en: ddp_train.py, a parameter-difference report and global-batch derivation.

zh: 两个 rank 使用不同且明确的输入子集
等效全局更新在声明容差内，或差异有可验证解释
en: Ranks receive distinct, documented input subsets
Equivalent updates meet the tolerance or have a testable explanation

noGpu.zh: 用 CPU/Gloo 和小模型完成相同的 DDP 语义验证；不把 CPU 加速情况外推到多 GPU。
noGpu.en: Use CPU/Gloo and a small model to validate the same DDP semantics. Do not extrapolate CPU scaling to GPUs.

title.zh: 验证数据覆盖与每轮采样
title.en: Verify data coverage and epoch sampling

lesson.zh: 数据并行不仅关乎通信，还关乎每个样本被谁看到。DistributedSampler 可以为 rank 划分索引，但数据量不能整除时可能补齐或丢弃；DataLoader 的 drop_last 又作用于批次，两层行为需要分开。每轮正确更新采样 epoch 才能得到预期的重新打乱。训练看似正常下降并不证明数据没有重复、遗漏或排序错误。
lesson.en: Data parallelism also determines who sees each sample. DistributedSampler partitions indices, but nondivisible dataset sizes may require padding or dropping examples. DataLoader's drop_last acts at the batch level and is a separate decision. Updating the sampler epoch enables the intended reshuffling. A decreasing training loss does not prove that samples are neither duplicated nor omitted, or that ordering is correct.

task.zh: 用 11 个带 ID 的样本和两个 rank 测试不同 drop_last 组合。保存每个 epoch、rank、step 的样本 ID，解释补齐、丢弃和 set_epoch 的效果。
task.en: Use 11 labeled samples and two ranks to test drop_last combinations. Log sample IDs by epoch, rank and step, explaining padding, dropping and the effect of set_epoch.

evidence.zh: sampler_audit.py、索引覆盖表与数据策略说明。
evidence.en: sampler_audit.py, an index-coverage table and a data-policy note.

zh: 能精确说明重复或丢弃了哪些样本及原因
至少对比两轮采样并验证预期变化
en: Identify exactly which samples are repeated/dropped and why
Compare at least two epochs and verify intended reshuffling

noGpu.zh: 样本索引审计可完全在 CPU 上进行，甚至不需要执行模型。
noGpu.en: Audit sample indices entirely on CPU without running a model.

title.zh: 用 torchrun 处理启动与失衡
title.en: Use torchrun and diagnose process imbalance

lesson.zh: 启动器负责建立进程环境，但不会修复训练代码中的同步不一致。一个 rank 提前退出、跳过 backward 或等待不同数据，都可能让其他进程停在集体通信。排障应记录 rank、步骤和通信边界，先判断是否所有进程走到同一位置，再排查网络。调大超时可能掩盖错误，应先解释为什么某个进程没有按预期参与。
lesson.en: A launcher establishes process environments but cannot fix inconsistent synchronization in training code. A rank that exits early, skips backward or waits for different input may leave peers blocked in a collective. Log ranks, steps and synchronization boundaries, checking whether every process reaches the same stage before blaming networking. A longer timeout can conceal a bug; first explain why a process failed to participate.

task.zh: 使用 torchrun 启动小型训练，打印 rank/local rank/world size。只在自己的短生命周期实验中制造一次可控延迟或显式异常，观察错误传播并编写全部进程退出与重启步骤。
task.en: Launch the toy job with torchrun and log rank/local rank/world size. In your own short-lived experiment, introduce one controlled delay or explicit exception. Observe error propagation and document complete shutdown and restart.

evidence.zh: launch.sh、分 rank 日志、故障定位与清理手册。
evidence.en: launch.sh, per-rank logs and a diagnosis/cleanup guide.

zh: 没有残留训练进程，异常退出有可识别日志
同步错误、数据等待和网络假设被分开分析
en: Leave no training processes behind and retain recognizable failure logs
Separate synchronization bugs, input waits and networking hypotheses

noGpu.zh: 两进程 CPU 实验足以练习启动、日志和退出；无需多机或 GPU。
noGpu.en: Two CPU processes are enough to practice launching, logging and shutdown; no cluster or GPU is needed.

title.zh: 保持梯度累积与精度语义一致

lesson.zh: 梯度累积用多个 microbatch 构成一次更新，影响有效 batch 和同步频率。若希望与一个大 batch 等价，需要处理 loss 缩放、清零时机和最后一次同步；DDP 的 no_sync 使用边界也必须符合官方约定。混合精度另有溢出、累加与缩放问题。先验证等效更新，再研究通信减少，不能把语义变化造成的差异误称为纯性能优化。
lesson.en: Gradient accumulation combines microbatches into one update, changing effective batch and synchronization frequency. Equivalence to a larger batch requires correct loss scaling, zeroing and final synchronization, including DDP's documented no_sync boundaries. Mixed precision introduces separate overflow and scaling concerns. Validate equivalent updates before investigating communication savings so that altered optimization semantics are not presented as a pure performance improvement.

task.zh: 比较一次大 batch 更新与两个 microbatch 累积更新，再在 DDP 中控制同步时机。记录有效全局 batch 与参数误差。具备适配 GPU 时选做混合精度，并记录数值异常处理。
task.en: Compare one large-batch update with two accumulated microbatches, then control synchronization in DDP. Record effective global batch and parameter error. On suitable GPUs, optionally study mixed precision and numerical failure handling.

evidence.zh: accumulation_test.py、等效性报告与可选精度实验。
evidence.en: accumulation_test.py, an equivalence report and optional precision experiments.

zh: loss 缩放、清零与更新次数可核对
不会把改变 batch 或训练目标的结果当作等价加速
en: Make loss scaling, zeroing and update counts inspectable
Do not label changed batch/objective semantics as an equivalent speedup

noGpu.zh: 使用 CPU 完成全精度累积与同步语义测试；混合精度 GPU 实验单独标为未执行。
noGpu.en: Validate full-precision accumulation and synchronization on CPU. Mark GPU mixed-precision experiments as unexecuted.

title.zh: 观察通信、计算与扩展效率

lesson.zh: 总训练时间由数据准备、计算、通信和等待共同决定。部分通信可能与反向计算重叠，所以把所有事件时长直接相加会高估总时间。扩展比较要说明固定的是全局 batch 还是每卡 batch，并使用实际处理样本数计算吞吐。两卡比单卡快不意味着多机线性加速；网络拓扑与小模型调度开销都会改变结果。
lesson.en: Training time includes input work, computation, communication and waiting. Communication may overlap backward computation, so summing every event duration can overestimate elapsed time. Scaling comparisons must state whether global or per-device batch is fixed and calculate throughput from actual processed samples. A two-device improvement does not imply linear multi-node scaling; topology and small-model overhead can substantially change the result.

task.zh: 为单进程和双 rank 训练采集短 profiler 记录，标出数据等待、forward/backward 与同步。按固定全局 batch 比较端到端步时和吞吐，报告预热与采样窗口。
task.en: Capture short profiler traces for single-process and two-rank training. Identify input wait, forward/backward and synchronization. Compare elapsed step time and throughput at fixed global batch, documenting warm-up and the measurement window.

evidence.zh: trace 文件、带注释时间线与 scaling.md。
evidence.en: Trace files, an annotated timeline and scaling.md.

zh: 区分累计算子时间与真实墙钟时间
全局 batch、处理样本数、预热和设备条件明确
en: Separate summed operator time from wall-clock time
State global batch, sample counts, warm-up and device conditions

noGpu.zh: CPU/Gloo 可以验证 trace 阅读和计时方法，但不能代表 NCCL 或 GPU 通信重叠。
noGpu.en: CPU/Gloo validates trace-reading and timing methods but does not represent NCCL or GPU overlap.

title.zh: 理解 FSDP2 的分片与临时聚合
title.en: Understand FSDP2 sharding and temporary gathering

lesson.zh: 当模型状态无法经济地复制到每张卡，分片可以减少常驻内存。FSDP2 通过 fully_shard 管理参数、梯度和优化器状态的分布，在计算需要时收集参数，再按策略释放完整副本。较小的分片单元可能降低峰值内存，却增加通信调度成本。新代码应参考 FSDP2 接口，不能把旧版 FSDP1 的示例无条件混用。
lesson.en: When replicating model state on every device is impractical, sharding can reduce resident memory. FSDP2 uses fully_shard to manage distributed parameters, gradients and optimizer state, gathering parameters for computation and releasing full copies according to policy. Smaller sharding units may lower peak memory while increasing communication overhead. New code should follow FSDP2 guidance rather than freely mixing older FSDP1 examples and interfaces.

task.zh: 为小模型画出 DDP 与 FSDP2 的状态分布，估算权重、梯度、优化器与临时完整参数占用。有适配多 GPU 环境时按官方教程运行最小 FSDP2 例子并核对包装与优化器创建顺序。
task.en: Diagram state placement under DDP and FSDP2 and estimate weights, gradients, optimizer state and temporary full parameters. On compatible multiple GPUs, run the minimal official FSDP2 example and verify sharding and optimizer-construction order.

evidence.zh: fsdp2-design.md、内存预算与可选的真实运行日志。
evidence.en: fsdp2-design.md, memory estimates and optional real-run logs.

zh: 峰值预算没有遗漏临时完整参数和通信开销
明确所用 FSDP2 API 与版本，不混称 FSDP1
en: Include temporary full parameters and communication overhead in peak estimates
Identify FSDP2 APIs/version and avoid confusing them with FSDP1

noGpu.zh: 完成状态分布、数组分片模拟和源码/教程解读；不假装在普通 CPU 上完成了同等 GPU FSDP2 性能测试。
noGpu.en: Complete state diagrams, array-sharding simulations and source/tutorial analysis. Do not present ordinary CPU work as equivalent GPU FSDP2 benchmarking.

lesson.zh: 恢复训练不仅需要模型权重，还可能需要优化器、学习率调度、随机状态、训练步数和数据进度。分布式检查点还涉及各 rank 的状态归属、存储可见性与同步。仅仅成功读取文件并不说明训练轨迹正确恢复；要比较中断前后的状态和后续更新。检查点格式与跨版本兼容能力也必须按当前实现验证。
lesson.en: Recovering training can require optimizer, scheduler, random state, step counters and data progress in addition to model weights. Distributed checkpoints add rank ownership, storage visibility and synchronization. Successfully reading a file does not prove that the training trajectory resumed correctly: compare state and subsequent updates. Checkpoint formats and cross-version compatibility must also be verified against the selected implementation.

task.zh: 在小训练任务固定步数处保存，退出后恢复，再与不中断训练的等效过程比较。DDP 路径先验证保存者与读取者同步；FSDP2 路径有硬件时按 DCP 官方流程选做。
task.en: Save a toy job at a fixed step, exit, restore and compare with equivalent uninterrupted training. For DDP, first validate writer/reader synchronization. With suitable hardware, optionally follow the official DCP workflow for FSDP2.

evidence.zh: resume_test.py、恢复前后状态对比、检查点清单与存储假设。
evidence.en: resume_test.py, pre/post-restore comparisons, checkpoint inventory and storage assumptions.

zh: 恢复包含训练所需状态，而不只是权重
恢复后的下一次更新符合声明容差或差异被解释
en: Restore required training state, not only weights
The next update meets the declared tolerance or differences are explained

noGpu.zh: 使用 CPU/DDP 完成完整中断与恢复测试；FSDP2/DCP 多 GPU 分片恢复保留为独立待验证项。
noGpu.en: Complete interruption/recovery on CPU/DDP. Keep multi-GPU FSDP2/DCP recovery as a separate unverified item.

title.zh: 交付一个可恢复的训练工程

lesson.zh: 一个合格的小型分布式作品应证明数据覆盖、梯度语义、故障处理和恢复，而不仅是打印多个 rank。用明确的工作负载解释为何选择 DDP 或 FSDP2，并指出何时才需要张量或流水线并行。大规模训练的网络、容错与成本优化仍需后续实战；本路线的目标是建立可以审查的基础工程证据。
lesson.en: A strong small distributed-training project demonstrates data coverage, gradient semantics, failure handling and recovery rather than merely printing multiple ranks. Explain the choice of DDP or FSDP2 for a specific workload and identify when tensor or pipeline parallelism would become relevant. Large-scale networking, resilience and cost optimization need further practice. This path establishes reviewable engineering foundations rather than cluster-scale expertise.

task.zh: 整合单进程、DDP、采样审计、恢复测试和性能记录。提供一个最小启动命令、已验证硬件列表、失败场景与清理步骤；写出下一阶段扩展到更大模型的决策表。
task.en: Integrate the baseline, DDP, sampling audit, recovery tests and performance records. Provide a minimal launch command, verified hardware list, failure cases and cleanup steps. Write a decision table for scaling to larger models.

evidence.zh: 分布式训练作品仓库、可复现报告与 DDP/FSDP2/TP 选型表。
evidence.en: A distributed-training portfolio, reproduction report and DDP/FSDP2/TP decision table.

zh: 从干净环境可复跑核心 CPU 或 GPU 路径
数据覆盖、有效 batch 和恢复均有测试证据
对未运行的 FSDP2/多机路径清楚标注
en: Reproduce the core CPU or GPU path from a clean environment
Provide evidence for data coverage, effective batch and recovery
Clearly label unexecuted FSDP2 or multi-node paths

noGpu.zh: CPU/DDP 小训练工程也可以成为完整作品；真实多 GPU 扩展图表须待相应实验后再添加。
noGpu.en: A CPU/DDP toy project is a valid completed portfolio. Add multi-GPU scaling plots only after those experiments are run.
